svg.title: local rate limiter token consumption sequence
svg.desc: LocalRateLimiter validates input, resolves a per-key LocalBucket, consumes by ConsumptionProbe, and maps the probe to a stable RateLimitResult.
svg.text: Local Rate Limiter Token Consumption Flow
One Bucket4j probe maps each attempt to consumed, rejected, or error.
Invalid requests fail before bucket lookup; cancellation is rethrown.
